name: Phantom Ring
body:
Aura strong transmutation; CL 13th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ghost ring. As soon as the wearer puts on the ring, she becomes incorporeal. The ring, however, does not allow the wearer to become corporeal. The wearer still requires food and water, but is limited to what she had on her person at the time she put on the ring.

Should the wearer die while still incorporeal, the wearer’s body and possessions remain in that state, but the ring becomes corporeal and falls free.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it from within the Ethereal Plane. Doing so destroys the ring and reverts the wearer to corporeal form.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ghost ring

Identification DC 38
False Identification DC 28
